_doc: Heart Raid (prototype, docs/design/PVE_HEART_RAID.md): the PvE mode on the expedition map. One squad of 1-4 Hunters (bots fill a squad of 4 offline) holds the Heart against waves and one boss while the Blight's tide closes. scripts/match/heart_raid.gd runs it. Seconds on the session clock, metres; the tide itself is heart.json's.
_match_s: the islands fall this many seconds in: the raid is lost if the squad has not won by then
_wave_every_s: a new wave this often; the last wave of the list ends the wave phase
_boss_s: the boss comes at this time, or boss_after_clear_s after the last wave is cleared, whichever is first

boss.name: Blighted Cairnback
boss._doc: the one prototype boss: a Lair boss kit (scripts/match/boss.gd) fought in the open around the Heart, named for the Boki it is (content/kin/*.json "boss"). hp is for a squad of 4 at tier 1 before scale.boss_hp; enrage = seconds before it hits harder (a Lair's is 75); half = the half-width in metres of the square it fights in, centred on the Heart

_warn_s: a wave's gates are marked (a ring and a countdown on the ground, a badge on the minimap) this many seconds before it comes out of them

gates._doc: the fixed points every wave comes out of (principle 1, clarity: never a random spot or time). deg: bearing from the Heart, clockwise from north (-z); m: metres from the Heart; guard: its monsters guard the Heart, else they come for the squad. An outer gate the tide has closed past is pulled in to EDGE_IN inside the ring the tide has at that wave's time (the same every raid)

_steer_r: a wave monster with nobody to fight goes for the nearest standing Hunter of the squad this close
_rally_r: bot Hunters of the squad farther than this from the fight's centre (the Heart, then the boss) are pinged back to it
_waves: each wave: its groups, each out of one gate (gates) with its monsters; a group's headcount is scaled by the squad (scale.count) and the difficulty (difficulty.count)

scale._doc: by squad size 1..4 (every Hunter in the squad, bots too): wave headcount, monster health, boss health, the cap on wave monsters alive at once

difficulty._doc: picked before the raid (HeartRaidPick, the lobby, --heart-raid=N:hard). Multiplies the squad scale: hp = wave monsters' health, dmg = the damage wave monsters and the boss deal, count = wave headcount and the alive cap, boss_hp = the boss's health; boss_extra = one more attack of the boss's kit (Boss.attacks: its lair's extra). Which raid Boki can turn up is boki_modes.json's min_difficulty. Order: boki_modes.json modes.heart_raid.difficulties

stand_ins._doc: TODO (until the raid's own Boki are modelled): the game species that stands in for a Heart Raid line of boki_modes.json while that line has no game kin. Same rarity as the line, so the draw tickets match; the line's min_difficulty gates it. Delete an entry once its line gets a kin

_blight_lvl: strength of the Blight monsters a wave brings (BlightDir.spawn level; 1 = full)

reward._doc: paid to each Hunter who holds the Heart ring once the boss is down (Heart.pay reads this in a Heart Raid). An egg of one of the raid's Boki open at the difficulty (HeartRaid.boki), fewer gems than the Expedition's major seat
